An admission auction is price discovery: 100 slots sell per epoch, each bid locks 3 epochs, and a pulse of demand lifts the price.

Each bid faces a vertex of checks: credential hashes block reuse, graph clusters flag coordinated wallets, and a 2-epoch window burns proven forgeries.

Honest losers get refunds minus 2%. At 60 units a slot, 1,000 identities cost 60,000. Doubled demand doubles the price to the summit: 10,000 fakes cost over 1,000,000.
